title: Metal Trunk

sources.title: Steel Watch Foundry
markers: A metal trunk near the elevator

summary: A portable or throwable metal container with 4 HP.

fields.Durability: 4 HP. Resistance to Piercing, Necrotic and Radiant damage. Vulnerable to Bludgeoning, immune to Poison and Psychic damage.
fields.Use: Can be picked up or thrown. Typical contents include randomized consumables, equipment, or other loot.
fields.Foundry trunk: The metal trunk near the Foundry elevator has a DC 25 Sleight of Hand lock and contains two to four random arrows and a Smokepowder Bomb.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
